This role ensures seamless connectivity between cloud services, on‑prem systems, third‑party applications, identity platforms, and automation workflows. The Specialist will work closely with Infrastructure, Security, and Business Technology teams to modernize processes, standardize system interactions, and enhance data flow across the enterprise. This role also administers the Microsoft 365 tenant and serves as the administrator and governance owner of the Microsoft Power Platform, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant use of Power Apps, Power Automate, and related services across the enterprise. This position is ideal for a technically strong, process‑minded professional who enjoys solving complex integration challenges, building scalable automation, and improving operational efficiency through M365‑centric solutions. Responsibilities Duties include, but not limited to: Microsoft 365 Administration Administer and configure Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Intune. Manage tenant-wide settings, licensing, and service health, and implement changes in line with change-management and security standards. Microsoft 365 Integration & Automation Design, develop, and maintain integrations across Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID). Build and manage automated workflows using Power Automate, Graph API, webhooks, and service connectors. Integrate M365 with business‑critical third‑party systems (HRIS, ERP, CRM, security tools, productivity platforms). Create standardized provisioning/deprovisioning processes using automation and directory synchronization multiple IDPs including Entra and Okta. Power Platform Administration & Governance Administer and govern the Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and related services. Manage environments, licensing and capacity, connectors, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, and platform security controls. Establish governance standards and processes that enable business-led app development while meeting security and compliance requirements. Partner with application-development teams to support their solutions while retaining ownership of platform administration and governance. Monitor platform health, usage, and adoption, and recommend improvements that increase value and reduce risk. Identity & Access Integration Implement and maintain identity integrations through Entra ID, including SSO, SCIM provisioning, conditional access flows, and group‑based policy automation. Support lifecycle integrations that rely on identity events (role changes, onboarding, offboarding, access certifications). Systems Architecture & Interoperability Assess system requirements and design integration pathways that enhance data flow, reduce redundancy, and improve operational efficiency. Collaborate with infrastructure teams to ensure integrations align with architectural standards, security policies, and compliance requirements. Evaluate emerging technologies and make recommendations for modernizing integration patterns. Monitoring, Logging & Compliance Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for integration flows using native M365 tools, SIEM platforms, and audit capabilities. Ensure integrations comply with organizational security standards, retention policies, data protection requirements, and regulatory frameworks. Maintain documentation for integration architecture, workflows, dependencies, and change history. Troubleshooting & Support Diagnose and resolve integration failures, data mismatches, API errors, permission issues, and workflow exceptions. Serve as an escalation point for M365‑related automation, Microsoft 365 administration, Power Platform governance, identity integrations, security configurations, and system interoperability issues. Partner with vendors when needed to address complex platform or connector issues. Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Work with business units to translate functional needs into technical integration requirements. Facilitate user adoption of integrated processes through clear documentation, training, and change‑management support. Participate in cross‑functional projects involving data modernization, automation, workflow redesign, or system migrations. Qualifications Citizenship: Must be a US citizen Minimum Required Qualifications Clearance : ability to obtain Education: Bachelor's Degree Years of Experience: 4-6+ Certifications: Microsoft certifications (MS‑900, SC‑300, AZ‑104, PL‑300, PL‑400) Preferred Qualifications Clearance : Secret Education: Bachelor's Degree Years of experience: 4-7 Certifications: Microsoft certifications (MS‑900, SC‑300, AZ‑104, PL‑300, PL‑400) Required Technical Skills 4–6+ years of experience in systems integration, cloud administration, or enterprise IT. Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365 services, Entra ID identity management, and Power Platform administration and governance. Experience building and managing APIs, connectors, automation flows, and cross‑system data interactions. Solid understanding of authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML, OpenID Connect), SCIM bridges, and security controls. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to isolate and resolve complex integration issues. Preferred Experience supporting hybrid environments, multi‑site organizations, or regulated industries. Familiarity with compliance frameworks, audit logging, incident response workflows, and enterprise security tools. Microsoft certifications (MS‑900, SC‑300, AZ‑104, PL‑300, PL‑400) preferred. Background process automation, or enterprise application architecture is a plus. Experience administering or integrating Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a plus. Experience with the Power Platform Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit, Managed Environments, and application lifecycle management (ALM). Familiarity with JSON, XML, and RESTful services. Interpersonal Skills Accountability Communication Collaboration Transparency Trust Additional Information Location: Remote Travel: 5% Remote, Onsite, or Hybrid: Wakefield HQ office or remote Company Overview Odyssey is a world-class technical, engineering, and integration company serving the warfighting ecosystem with airborne integration, ISR, C2, and warfighter readiness capabilities. Odyssey meets the military’s operational needs by integrating layered defense systems from equipment, technology, and services to data, information, and business operations. We streamline defense acquisition and sustainment, engineering the technical battlefield with domain-specific proficiency to ensure lethality. Odyssey is dedicated to excellent contract execution, peak organizational performance, and fostering a workplace built on employee care. Odyssey is proud to live out our core values of commitment, ambition, and respect in our work and communities through OdysseyCares , a philanthropic group focused on giving back through direct donations, an employer match program, and volunteering events. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals With Disabilities Please Note: Final compensation for this position will be determined by various factors such as the Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant work experience, specific skills and competencies, geographic location, education, and certifications. Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, Tricare supplement, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, employee assistance program, learning and development benefit, paid time off, and holidays.
